title: Atomic Transfer
prompt: Implement transfer(conn, src, dst, amount) moving money between rows of accounts(id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, balance INTEGER). Raise ValueError if either account is missing or src has insufficient funds (and roll back). On success, commit.

tests.name: moves the money
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, balance INTEGER)')
conn.executemany('INSERT INTO accounts VALUES (?, ?)', [(1, 100), (2, 0)])
conn.commit()
transfer(conn, 1, 2, 40)
bals = dict(conn.execute('SELECT id, balance FROM accounts'))
assert bals == {1: 60, 2: 40}

tests.name: insufficient funds rejected atomically
tests.code:
import sqlite3
conn = sqlite3.connect(':memory:')
conn.execute('CREATE TABLE accounts (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, balance INTEGER)')
conn.executemany('INSERT INTO accounts VALUES (?, ?)', [(1, 10), (2, 0)])
conn.commit()
try:
    transfer(conn, 1, 2, 50)
    failed = False
except ValueError:
    failed = True
assert failed
bals = dict(conn.execute('SELECT id, balance FROM accounts'))
assert bals == {1: 10, 2: 0}
tests.hint: Nothing changes when the transfer is rejected — rollback.
